run_get_stats: run the script to poll gRPC server statistics via channelz on a given address
run_channelz_getservers: run a gRPC channelz GetServers request to retrieve info for all registered servers
create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to connect to a server at a specified address
review_run_function: review the run function that connects via channelz stub and prints server information
summarize_main_function: summarize the main function that parses CLI args and calls run with the target address
